caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark brown, metallic-looking bowl positioned horizontally in the center of a plain, light beige background. The bowl is round and shallow with a gradually widening rim, and it has a distinctive rounded handle that extends to the right and curves into a loop. The overall shading gives it a textured, slightly worn appearance. There are no additional objects present in the drawing, and the only text visible is the name "P. Puffinbarger" written in small, simple capital letters below and slightly to the right of the bowl.
title: Drinking Cup
